name: Stop
description: You must bring your vehicle to a complete stop behind the stop line. Only proceed when the way is clear and it is safe to do so.

name: Yield
description: You must give right-of-way to all traffic at the intersection. Slow down and stop if necessary before proceeding.

name: No Parking
description: Parking is prohibited at all times. You may stop momentarily to drop off or pick up a passenger, but must not leave the vehicle unattended.

name: No Stopping
description: No vehicle may stop at any time in this zone — more restrictive than No Parking. Even momentary stops to drop off passengers are forbidden.

name: No U-Turn
description: U-turns are prohibited at this intersection or road section. You must continue in your current direction or choose an alternative route.

name: No Left Turn
description: Turning left is prohibited at this intersection. You must proceed straight ahead or turn right.

name: No Right Turn
description: Turning right is prohibited at this intersection. You must proceed straight ahead or turn left.

name: No Entry
description: No vehicles of any kind may enter the road beyond this sign. This sign is often placed at the exit of a one-way street.

name: No Vehicles in Both Directions
description: No vehicles may travel in either direction. The road is closed to all traffic.

name: No Motor Vehicles
description: Motor vehicles are prohibited from using this road. Non-motorised transport such as bicycles may still be permitted.

name: No Motorcycles
description: Motorcycles and mopeds are prohibited from using this road or lane.

name: No Goods Vehicles
description: Goods vehicles (trucks and freight vehicles) are prohibited. Usually posted on roads with weight or clearance restrictions.

name: No Buses
description: Buses are prohibited from using this road or entering this zone.

name: No Minibus Taxis
description: Minibus taxis are prohibited from this road or area. Applies to vehicles used as public passenger transport with more than eight seats.

name: No Animal-drawn Vehicles
description: Vehicles drawn by animals (e.g. carts, wagons) are prohibited from using this road.

name: No Bicycles
description: Bicycles are prohibited from using this road or lane. Cyclists must use an alternative route.

name: No Pedestrians
description: Pedestrians are prohibited from using this road. A separate pedestrian route must be available nearby.

name: Speed Limit 20 km/h
description: The maximum speed on this road is 20 km/h. Typically found in pedestrian zones, school entrances, or parking areas.

name: Speed Limit 30 km/h
description: The maximum speed on this road is 30 km/h. Common in residential streets and school zones.

name: Speed Limit 40 km/h
description: The maximum speed on this road is 40 km/h.

name: Speed Limit 60 km/h
description: The maximum speed on this road is 60 km/h — the default limit inside urban areas unless otherwise indicated.

name: Speed Limit 80 km/h
description: The maximum speed on this road is 80 km/h. Common on rural roads or roads leaving urban areas.

name: Speed Limit 100 km/h
description: The maximum speed on this road is 100 km/h. Found on open roads outside urban areas that are not freeways.

name: Speed Limit 120 km/h
description: The maximum speed is 120 km/h — the default freeway limit in South Africa unless otherwise posted.

name: End of Speed Restriction
description: The previously imposed speed restriction ends here. Revert to the general speed limit applicable to the road type.

name: Minimum Speed 40 km/h
description: You must travel at a minimum of 40 km/h on this road. Typically used on freeways or high-speed expressways to maintain traffic flow.

name: No Overtaking
description: Overtaking is prohibited. You may not pass another vehicle moving in the same direction on this stretch of road.

name: End of No Overtaking
description: The no-overtaking restriction ends here, provided it is safe and legal to overtake under general traffic rules.

name: Proceed Straight Only
description: You must proceed straight ahead. Turning in any direction at this intersection is prohibited.

name: Turn Left
description: You must turn left at this intersection. Proceeding straight or turning right is not permitted.

name: Turn Right
description: You must turn right at this intersection. Proceeding straight or turning left is not permitted.

name: Proceed Straight or Turn Left
description: You may only proceed straight ahead or turn left at this intersection. Turning right is prohibited.

name: Proceed Straight or Turn Right
description: You may only proceed straight ahead or turn right at this intersection. Turning left is prohibited.

name: Turn Left or Right
description: You must turn — either left or right. Proceeding straight ahead is not permitted at this intersection.

name: Keep Left
description: You must keep to the left of the island, refuge, or obstruction indicated. Do not drive to the right of it.

name: Keep Right
description: You must keep to the right of the island, refuge, or obstruction indicated.

name: Roundabout
description: You are entering a roundabout. Give way to traffic already in the roundabout and travel in the direction shown (anti-clockwise in South Africa).

name: Curve to the Right
description: A curve to the right lies ahead. Reduce speed and position your vehicle to negotiate the curve safely.

name: Sharp Curve to the Right
description: A sharp curve to the right lies immediately ahead. Significantly reduce speed before entering the curve.

name: Sharp Curve to the Left
description: A sharp curve to the left lies immediately ahead. Significantly reduce speed before entering the curve.

name: Winding Road
description: The road ahead has a series of curves. Keep your speed down and remain alert for each successive bend.

name: Steep Descent
description: A steep downhill gradient lies ahead. Engage a lower gear before descending. Do not ride the brakes — use engine braking.

name: Steep Ascent
description: A steep uphill gradient lies ahead. Select a lower gear in advance to maintain momentum and avoid stalling.

name: Uneven Road
description: The road surface ahead is uneven or bumpy. Reduce speed to avoid loss of control or vehicle damage.

name: Road Humps
description: Speed humps or road bumps lie ahead. Reduce speed significantly before reaching them to avoid damage and loss of control.

name: Low Clearance
description: A bridge, tunnel, or overhead structure ahead has limited vertical clearance. High vehicles must find an alternative route.

name: Opening Bridge
description: An opening (bascule or swing) bridge lies ahead. The bridge may open to allow waterway traffic — be prepared to stop.

name: T-Junction Ahead
description: A T-junction lies ahead where the road ends. You will have to turn either left or right.

name: Crossroad Ahead
description: A crossroad (four-way junction) lies ahead. Be prepared to yield, stop, or navigate according to the controls at the intersection.

name: Side Road on the Right
description: A side road joins from the right ahead. Traffic from the side road must yield to you, but be alert for vehicles entering the main road.

name: Side Road on the Left
description: A side road joins from the left ahead. Traffic from the side road must yield to you.

name: Y-Junction
description: The road ahead splits into a Y-fork. Observe the road markings and signage to determine right-of-way.

name: Staggered Junction — Right then Left
description: A staggered junction lies ahead where roads meet first from the right, then from the left. Proceed with caution.

name: Staggered Junction — Left then Right
description: A staggered junction lies ahead where roads meet first from the left, then from the right.

name: Railway Level Crossing — Unguarded
description: An unguarded (no boom or gate) railway level crossing lies ahead. Stop, look both ways, and only cross when no train is approaching.

name: Traffic Signal Ahead
description: A set of traffic lights lies ahead. Prepare to stop and observe the signals.

name: Stop Sign Ahead
description: A stop sign lies ahead. Begin slowing down now to bring your vehicle to a complete stop at the stop line.

name: Yield Sign Ahead
description: A yield sign lies ahead. Prepare to give way to traffic on the road you are about to join.

name: Narrow Bridge
description: A narrow bridge lies ahead where two-way traffic may not be able to pass simultaneously. Slow down and be prepared to yield.

name: Pedestrian Crossing
description: A marked pedestrian crossing lies ahead. Be prepared to stop and yield to pedestrians crossing the road.

name: School Children
description: A school is nearby and children may be crossing the road. Reduce speed and be especially alert for young pedestrians.

name: Cyclist Crossing
description: A cycle path crosses the road ahead. Look out for cyclists crossing from either side of the road.

name: Playing Children
description: Children may be playing in or near the road ahead. Reduce speed and proceed with great caution.

name: Railway Level Crossing — Guarded
description: A guarded railway level crossing (with boom/gate) lies ahead. Stop when the boom is down or lights are flashing.

name: Road Narrows on Both Sides
description: The road ahead narrows on both sides. Be prepared to reduce speed and allow oncoming vehicles to pass.

name: Road Narrows on the Left
description: The road narrows from the left side ahead. Keep right and slow down.

name: Road Narrows on the Right
description: The road narrows from the right side ahead. Keep left and slow down.

name: Two-Way Traffic Ahead
description: You are entering a section of two-way traffic after a one-way section. Keep left and watch for oncoming vehicles.

name: Dead End
description: The road ahead is a dead end — there is no through route. Only enter if your destination is on this road.

name: Low Clearance Ahead
description: A structure with low overhead clearance lies ahead. Vehicles that exceed the indicated height must not proceed.

name: Slippery Road
description: The road surface ahead is slippery, especially when wet. Reduce speed, avoid harsh braking or sharp steering, and increase your following distance.

name: Loose Stones or Gravel
description: Loose gravel or stones lie on the road surface ahead. Reduce speed to avoid tyre damage and stones being thrown up by your wheels.

name: Sand Drift
description: Sand drifts across the road in this area. Reduce speed — sand patches can cause sudden loss of traction.

name: Flooding
description: This road is subject to flooding. The road may be submerged in heavy rain — do not attempt to cross flooded sections.

name: Low Water Bridge or Causeway
description: A low-level bridge or causeway lies ahead that may be submerged during heavy rain or floods. Check depth before crossing.

name: Dip
description: A dip in the road lies ahead. Reduce speed — the dip may be sharper than it appears and may conceal hazards.

name: Road Works
description: Road construction or maintenance work is in progress ahead. Reduce speed, watch for workers and machinery, and follow all temporary signs.

name: Road Works — Lane Closed
description: A lane ahead is closed due to road works. Merge early, reduce speed, and follow temporary lane markings.

name: Flagman Ahead
description: A person directing traffic lies ahead at a road works site. Obey all hand signals given by the traffic flagman.

name: Cattle Ahead
description: Cattle may be crossing or on the road ahead. Reduce speed significantly — animals can move unpredictably.

name: Wild Animals
description: Wild animals may cross the road ahead. This sign is common near game reserves and nature areas. Slow down and be vigilant, especially at dawn and dusk.

name: Horse Riders
description: Horse riders may be using the road ahead. Pass slowly and wide — sudden noise or movement can startle horses.

name: Pedestrians in Road
description: Pedestrians may be walking in the road ahead, typically in a rural area without a pavement. Reduce speed and be prepared to stop.

name: Children in Road
description: Children may be playing or walking in the road ahead. Drive slowly and be ready to stop immediately.

name: Hospital
description: A hospital with emergency medical services is nearby. Follow directional signs to reach the facility.

name: Parking Area
description: A designated parking area is available ahead. Vehicles may be left here for extended periods unless signs indicate time restrictions.

name: Police Station
description: A police station is located nearby. Follow directional signage to reach it.

name: Fuel / Petrol Station
description: A fuel station is available nearby. Useful information for long-distance travel planning.

name: Restaurant
description: A restaurant or eating establishment is available in the vicinity.

name: Telephone
description: A public telephone is available nearby. Emergency call boxes are also indicated by this sign on remote roads.

name: First Aid
description: A first aid post or medical facility is located nearby.

name: Fire Extinguisher
description: A fire extinguisher is located at the indicated point — typically posted in tunnels, garages, or at fuel storage areas.

name: Camping Site
description: A camping site is available nearby. Typically found on routes leading to nature reserves and rest camps.

name: Caravan Park
description: A caravan or trailer park is available in the vicinity for overnight accommodation.

name: Viewpoint
description: A scenic viewpoint lies ahead. You may stop and park to enjoy the view.

name: Hotel or Accommodation
description: Accommodation (hotel, guesthouse, or lodge) is available nearby.

name: National Route Marker
description: Identifies a national route (N-road). National routes are the major inter-city and inter-provincial highways of South Africa.

name: Regional Route Marker
description: Identifies a regional route (R-road). Regional routes connect towns and cities within provinces.

name: Metropolitan Route Marker
description: Identifies a metropolitan route (M-road). Metropolitan routes are found within large urban areas.

name: One Way — Right
description: This is a one-way road and traffic flows to the right (in the direction of the arrow). Do not enter from the opposite end.

name: One Way — Left
description: This is a one-way road and traffic flows to the left (in the direction of the arrow). Do not enter from the opposite end.
